name: Photo-count control: 8 near-identical fronts
means: An ARM of the photo-count experiment on the synthetic stand-in (STANDIN-A): 8 near-identical fronts, fixed-count spread control. Not a pickable style - kept so the measurement can be re-run and its verdict re-checked.
